search_updates.claim: no Colombian department criminalises anything about being trans; gender-identity recognition administered nationally
search_updates.found: Consistent: Outright International reports legal protections against discrimination/harassment on sexual orientation AND gender identity grounds in Colombia (enforcement weak), no criminalisation statutes; 2026 context: Colombia withdrew from the Equal Rights Coalition (De la Espriella administration) and a Comprehensive Trans Law reached bill-presentation in Congress June 2026
